summary: Iteration 20: Codified the storyline-spawn CLARIFICATION GATE in pytest. 22 new tests added covering: vague-short-action triggers clarification, all 11 vague verbs (look/find/check/see/go/search/explore/wander/scout/watch/head), filler-word stripping (i'm/im/i'll/ill), -ing suffix normalization, concrete-long-action spawns directly with transition_narration, narration_context bypass, whitespace-only narration_context still triggers gate, 400/404 input validation. 20/22 passed, 2 skipped (LLM classifier returned is_off_hook=false for 'see' and 'explore' inputs — expected flake guarded by pytest.skip per agent_to_agent_context_note).

minor.issue: Successful spawn response (spawned=true) does NOT echo is_off_hook=true back; only the short-circuit branches (on-hook OR clarification) include is_off_hook in the body. Minor API inconsistency — recommend always including is_off_hook in response for client convenience. Worked around in tests.

Verbs 'see' and 'explore' (e.g. 'I see for a sloop') occasionally classified as is_off_hook=false even when the action plainly diverges. Not a regression — pre-existing LLM flake. Heuristic gate code is unreachable when classifier says on-hook, so functional impact is bounded.

action_items: (Optional) Have the successful-spawn return path include is_off_hook=true for response-shape consistency with the clarification/on-hook branches.

(Pre-existing, not iter-20) Fix PYTHONPATH/import for test_offhook_spawn.py::TestPendingObligationsPromptBlock — 3 tests fail to import 'services' module unless pytest is run from /app/backend. Same applies to test_global_dm_lessons.py which fails at collection because REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL os.environ.get(...) has no default and the .rstrip is called on None when env not set.
critical_code_review_comments: storylines.py line 516: `first_word.rstrip('e')` is overly aggressive — it strips trailing 'e' from ANY normalized word, so 'examine' -> 'examin' (harmless, not in set) but 'see' -> 's' (definitely breaks the vague-verb match). This is likely why the 'see' case skipped: even if classifier said is_off_hook=true, 'see' -> 's' would NOT match VAGUE_VERBS. Recommend removing the rstrip('e') line or making it conditional (e.g. only when the word ended in 'ing' so 'searching' -> 'search' is preserved without harming 'see').

storylines.py line 518: the `(first_word + 'k') in VAGUE_VERBS` fallback is opaque — appears intended to recover 'loo' -> 'look' after a hypothetical 'looing' but no comment explains intent. Add a comment or remove.
Response schema inconsistency: only the short-circuit branches return `is_off_hook`. Add it on the success branch (line 703) so callers don't have to special-case three response shapes.
seed_data_creation: Each test module creates a single fresh campaign via /api/campaigns/draft and reuses it across the 22 tests for latency efficiency.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter 20 codified the clarification-gate. New test file: /app/backend/tests/test_spawn_clarification.py. Skips are LLM-classifier dependent (is_off_hook flake) and are EXPECTED — they assert structural properties only when the classifier cooperates, per main-agent note. If 'see' or 'explore' need to be deterministically tested, fix the rstrip('e') bug in storylines.py:516 first. Regression suite confirmed iter 13-19 API tests still pass (23 passed). 3 pre-existing failures in test_offhook_spawn.py are PYTHONPATH issues unrelated to this iteration. test_global_dm_lessons.py also has a pre-existing collection error from a missing env default — flag for main agent in a future cleanup pass.
rca of the issue: n/a — this iteration is feature-codification, not bug-RCA. The two skips have a partial RCA: the rstrip('e') line at storylines.py:516 turns 'see' into 's' before checking VAGUE_VERBS, so even if the classifier flags 'I see for a sloop' as off-hook, the heuristic gate will silently miss it. Same bug would affect 'I see the merchant' (1-word filler stripped then 'see' -> 's').
